title: Trey Qua - TEL AVIV
htmlContent:
Trey Qua shares a new single called "TEL AVIV". The single "Tel Aviv" is based on the breakup of a toxic relationship. The music is truly incredible and shows the emotional connection music can have with the listener, when done with extra care. The passion and vibes of the record is special, and will keep you coming back to this masterpiece that he gives to the world to enjoy on what is some of his finest work.

"Tel Aviv" is a song that lives up to the title, as it gives you a high with every listen. The music has a vibe to it that shines to the fullest, and makes you want the song to never end on this record that feels blissful for every second he gives us. If you need good music in your life, the search can end here on this record you can enjoy in every way without limits.
